requirement.description: {reliability_ruth} proposed moving acceptance criteria checks off manual handling. The less anyone has to check that by hand, the sooner feedback reaches the team.
requirement.fact: {reliability_ruth} proposed moving acceptance criteria checks off manual handling.
requirement.reading: The less anyone has to check that by hand, the sooner feedback reaches the team.

speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I am not asking for a full automation of the acceptance criteria yet, just to stop the manual bottleneck so we get faster feedback. I want the checks to run automatically, but I still need a human to sign off on the results before we deploy.
output.correction: You are mixing up the automation of the check with the governance of the approval. I am moving the execution to a tool, but the decision to accept the model remains a manual, governed step.
